text:
NovaStream Analytics is a fast-growing analytics platform helping e-commerce brands predict demand and optimize inventory in real time. We combine high-velocity event processing with ML-driven forecasting to cut stockouts and waste. We’re a small, outcome-focused team moving fast — looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own our data pipelines and operational analytics layer.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines that ingest event and batch sources into our warehouse.
- Implement DAGs and orchestration using Apache Airflow to schedule, monitor and recover data workflows.
- Build reliable transformations and data models that power downstream analytics and ML features.
- Collaborate with ML engineers, product and analytics to translate requirements into production data assets.
- Improve pipeline performance, observability and SLAs; own root-cause and on-call incidents for data systems.
- Drive best practices for testing, CI/CD, data quality checks and documentation.

What we need (mandatory)
- Python
- Apache Airflow
- 6+ years

Preferred / Good-to-have
- Snowflake
- dbt
- Apache Kafka

Bonus points
- Experience instrumenting data quality and lineage tools.
- Background in real-time or near-real-time event processing for analytics.
- Prior work in early-stage startups where you shipped end-to-end data products.

Location and work mode
Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
